annotations.title: Job offer letter with pay math

description: Job offer letter with pay math — Draft a job offer letter (role, pay; optional company, candidate, payType salary|hourly, hours, frequency weekly|biweekly|semimonthly|monthly, start, bonus, equity, benefits, location, manager, contingencies, expiresDays). Exact offline pay math (annual, monthly, per paycheck, hourly equivalent), acceptance deadline in business days, start-date weekend/holiday check, federal FLSA exempt-salary ($684/week) and minimum-wage flags, and checks that the letter states pay exactly, adds no invented numbers and includes at-will language. Not legal advice. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_offer_letter
